$comment: THE PLUTUS CONTEXT NAVIGATION MANIFEST — the graph drill-down index. Stage-3 of the bootload: after reading PLUTUS_MASTER_CONTEXT_INJECTOR.md, use these pre-wired queries for ANY drill-down. Each query is bounded (200-500 tokens) — NEVER read the 126MB shared.db, NEVER re-read the corpus docs. The graph paths are corbell-scope-era STALE — resolve by symbol name, never raw path.

graph.driver: bun:sqlite readonly (the sqlite3 CLI is ABSENT): new Database(path, {readonly:true})
graph.stale_path_warning: graph_nodes.file points at corbell-scope/ (a dead layout) and some line anchors have moved — resolve by node NAME, verify against the live tree, never trust the raw path

start_here.the_pipeline_entry: SELECT name, file, line FROM graph_nodes WHERE name = 'buildE2Core' OR name = 'runChainV452' OR name = 'loadFixture'
start_here.the_frozen_pair: SELECT name, file, line FROM graph_nodes WHERE name IN ('computeSL_LMV') -- sl-lmv.ts:177 verified live; trade-dedup by name 'dedup'
start_here.the_e2_injection: SELECT name, file, line FROM graph_nodes WHERE name = 'injectShapeSequence'
start_here.the_tp_machine: SELECT name, file, line FROM graph_nodes WHERE name = 'computeLmvTP' -- graph says mirror.ts:2968 STALE; live tree 1533-1591
start_here.canon_law_cards: SELECT id, severity, quote, anchor FROM rule_cards ORDER BY CASE severity WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 0 WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, CAST(id AS INTEGER) LIMIT 25
start_here.the_generation_pin: SELECT battery_version, COUNT(*) FROM compiled_predicates GROUP BY 1 -- pin bc6ce1a0584a

drill_downs.topic: who calls a pipeline function (blast radius before an edit)
drill_downs.query: SELECT n.name, n.file, n.line FROM graph_edges e JOIN graph_nodes n ON n.id = e.source_id JOIN graph_nodes t ON t.id = e.target_id WHERE t.name = $SYMBOL AND e.kind = 'calls'

drill_downs.topic: the call chain between two functions
drill_downs.query: the client verb chain($from, $to) via src/graph/client.ts (BFS depth<=64) OR the recursive calls-edge walk

drill_downs.topic: the full canon quote behind a law
drill_downs.query: SELECT quote, anchor, classification, severity FROM rule_cards WHERE quote LIKE '%' || $FRAGMENT || '%' LIMIT 5

drill_downs.topic: all findings against a file (the enforcement history)
drill_downs.query: SELECT severity, file, line, verdict, evidence FROM findings WHERE file LIKE '%' || $FILENAME || '%' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT name, file, line FROM graph_nodes WHERE name = $SYMBOL -- THEN verify on the live tree: grep -n 'function $SYMBOL\|$SYMBOL =' src/
the injector section's file:line anchors ARE the drill-down index — grep the anchor symbol in shared.db graph_nodes

jesl_kernel_work: injector ### 1.8 (search '### 1.8 THE JESL KERNEL LAW' — the kernel law section)
injector ### 5E (search '### 5E — THE JESL CONTRACTS' — the TS/JSON contracts)
query: SELECT name, line FROM graph_nodes WHERE name IN ('Executor','Journal','NodeRegistry') OR name LIKE 'defaultRegistry' OR name LIKE '%Node'
e1_zone_engine_work: injector ### 8.3 (the LMV machine — search '### 8.3 THE LMV MACHINE')
query: SELECT name, line FROM graph_nodes WHERE name IN ('buildChartModel','buildLmvTable','computeLmvTP','detectZonesObcv')
testing_gate_work: query: rule_cards quote LIKE '%THREE pips%' OR quote LIKE '%golden%'

verify_protocol.2_kernel: bun test src/jesl/ -- HELLO-GATE ALL GREEN
verify_protocol.fail_action: ANY drift → the injector's state is STALE → re-verify the drift, append a §6 version line, THEN operate

_slice_markers._note: the injector's Part-I law sections use '### N.N' headers inside '## §N' parents; the corpus layers use '## §N' — slice by the exact strings in this map
